title: Accurate prediction of mediolateral episiotomy risk during labor: development and verification of an artificial intelligence model.
summary: Records from 3,141 deliveries were screened; eligible vaginal deliveries were divided for model development and validation.
ai_technology: A prospective model predicts mediolateral episiotomy during vaginal delivery using maternal and obstetric features.
organization: Sichuan University-The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Institute for Disaster Management and Reconstruction, Chengdu, 610041, China
